summary: Verified SEO/branding bug fix on VOKTAA marketing site preview. document.title, meta description/author, og:* tags, and manifest.json all match the required values. No 'Fullstack App' or 'A product of emergent.sh' text remains in the served HTML. Home page regression clean: hero 'Every voice has an ascent.', navbar (HOME/ABOUT/PROGRAMS/CONTACT + BOOK A FREE DEMO), and WhatsApp float button all render.
verified_items: meta[name=description] contains 'VOKTAA equips students and professionals', 'Andhra Pradesh', 'classroom to career'
/manifest.json returns 200 with name='VOKTAA Solutions', short_name='VOKTAA', description='Soft skills and communication training academy'
No 'Fullstack App' or 'A product of emergent.sh' text in served HTML
Hero, navbar and WhatsApp float render (regression OK)
critical_code_review_comments: manifest.json has empty icons array — Chrome/PWA install banners and some social previews expect at least one 192x192 and 512x512 icon. Non-blocking for this SEO fix but recommended follow-up.
og:image (and twitter:image) are not defined — social share previews will lack an image thumbnail. Consider adding an og:image URL for LinkedIn/WhatsApp/Twitter cards.
No canonical link tag (<link rel='canonical' href='https://voktaa.com/'>) — recommended for SEO given og:url points to production while preview host differs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEO metadata verified via headless browser at preview URL. If future iterations touch index.html or add react-helmet, re-verify document.title is not overridden at runtime.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — this was a verification pass. Previous placeholder branding was replaced statically in /app/frontend/public/index.html; no React component sets document.title, so static title persists.
